cards.name: Ceiling Cat
cards.caption: Ceiling Cat is watching u
cards.flavor: Lolcat scripture, 2007: a cat peeks through a hole in the ceiling and judges you.
cards.art: Ginger-and-white cat head poking down through a ragged square hole in a plain gray ceiling, wide round eyes staring straight at the viewer, whiskers dangling. Background: smooth gray ceiling fading darker. Colors: ginger, white, gray.

cards.name: Keyboard Cat
cards.caption: Play him off, Keyboard Cat
cards.flavor: Taped in 1984, crowned in 2009: a cat in a blue shirt plays every fail video off stage.
cards.art: Ginger-and-white tabby cat in a light blue T-shirt sitting upright behind a vintage electric keyboard, front paws on the keys, deadpan stare at the viewer. Background: plain beige living-room wall, warm 1980s home-video look. Colors: ginger, light blue, beige, black.

cards.name: Y U NO Guy
cards.caption: Y U NO PULL LEGENDARY
cards.flavor: Rage comics, 2010: arms up, mouth wide, grammar optional. Y U NO?
cards.art: Black-and-white rage-comic drawing: huge round white head with furious bulging eyes, gritted teeth and a scrunched nose, small body in a white shirt throwing both hands up in exasperation. Background: flat dark blue. Colors: white, black, slate blue.

cards.name: Planking
cards.caption: Face down, arms by sides
cards.flavor: 2011's least athletic sport: lie face-down, stiff as a board, somewhere weird.
cards.art: A faceless person in a green T-shirt and jeans lying perfectly stiff, face-down, across the top of a stack of red and blue storage crates on a store shelf, arms pinned to their sides, face hidden. Background: pegboard store wall. Colors: green, denim blue, red, tan.

cards.name: Dramatic Chipmunk
cards.caption: DUN DUN DUNNNN
cards.flavor: 2007's five-second epic: a 'chipmunk' (it's a prairie dog) turns and stares.
cards.art: Extreme close-up of a tan prairie dog that has just whipped its head toward the camera, one beady dark eye, nose in profile, fur slightly blurred like a zoomed TV frame. Background: flat blue studio sky. Colors: tan, blue, dark brown.

cards.name: Longcat
cards.caption: Longcat is looooong
cards.flavor: Imageboard legend, 2007: a white cat held up so long it never seems to end.
cards.art: A white cat held up under the front legs by a pair of hands, front paws reaching out to the sides, body stretching impossibly far down past the bottom of the frame, calm face. Background: wood-panel wall. Colors: white, pink, warm wood.

cards.name: Arrow to the Knee
cards.caption: Took an arrow to the knee
cards.flavor: Skyrim, 2011: every guard 'used to be an adventurer like you.' Then... ouch.
cards.art: Fantasy town guard in a full-face iron helmet with a nose guard, mustard-yellow tabard over chainmail, round wooden shield, standing in a cobbled medieval town. Background: stone wall and timber house. Colors: mustard, steel gray, brown.

cards.name: Philosoraptor
cards.caption: Are we the memes now?
cards.flavor: 2008 advice animal: a velociraptor stroking its chin over unanswerable questions.
cards.art: Green velociraptor head in profile drawn in heavy black ink, one claw raised to its chin, eyes narrowed in deep thought. Background: two-tone green diagonal split. Colors: lime green, sage, black.

cards.name: Gangnam Style
cards.caption: Oppa Gangnam Style!
cards.flavor: 2012: the first video to hit 1 billion YouTube views had the whole planet horse-dancing.
cards.art: Cartoon of a round-faced singer in black sunglasses and a black suit doing the invisible-horse dance, wrists crossed in front of his chest, knees bent. Background: cartoon horse stable with tiled floor. Colors: black, cream, tan, teal.

cards.name: Trollface
cards.caption: Problem?
cards.flavor: Since 2008, the MS Paint grin behind every prank, bait link and 'u mad?'
cards.art: Original black-and-white MS Paint-style line drawing (not a copy) of a wide, smug, lumpy face with an enormous toothy grin stretching ear to ear, squinting mischievous eyes and raised brows. Background: plain white. Colors: black, white, light gray.

cards.name: Nyan Cat
cards.caption: Nyan nyan nyan nyan nyan
cards.flavor: 2011's 10-hour loop: a pastry-bodied pixel cat zooming through space on a rainbow.
cards.art: Pixel-art gray cat with a rectangular pink-frosted toaster-pastry body with sprinkles, flying to the right, six-stripe rainbow trail behind, twinkling pixel stars. Background: dark navy space. Colors: gray, pink, tan, rainbow stripes, navy.

cards.name: Rickroll
cards.caption: Never gonna give you up
cards.flavor: Since 2007 every link might be a trap. You know the rules, and so do I.
cards.art: Faceless figure seen in silhouette with a tall swoopy ginger pompadour, oversized beige trench coat over a black turtleneck, mid side-step dance with fists pumping, no face visible. Background: foggy late-80s music-video set with a brick wall. Colors: beige, black, ginger, blue haze.
